title: zaluzianskia gymnocarpa
intro: Zaluzianskia gymnocarpa, commonly known as Chinese prickly rose, is a flowering plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Zaluzianskia gymnocarpa include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's overall medicinal value and potential applications in the development of new therapeutic agents.
